		private COIdentifiers.COVersions getUnitVersion(ref object unit)

		private void postInitialize(ref bool isRecalling)
		{
			refreshUnitReportsList(ref isRecalling);
			if (hyUtils.isHYSYS3())
			{
				if (EnableLogicals.Value != 0.0)
				{
					string title = "Restoring from an older Hysys version";

					EnableLogicals.Value = 0.0;
				}
				bool aPassParams = true;
				exposeCOParsToHysys(ref aPassParams);
			}
		}

		public ICapeParameter getParamByName(ref string name)
		{
			ICapeParameter capeParameter = null;
			int num = params_Count();
			for (int i = 1; i <= num; i = checked(i + 1))
			{
				capeParameter = (ICapeParameter)params_item(ref i);
				if (Operators.CompareString(((ICapeIdentification)capeParameter).ComponentName, name, TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return capeParameter;

		private bool isAttachable(ref ProcessStream stream, ref string direction)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			FixedAttachments fixedAttachments = default(FixedAttachments);
			if (Operators.CompareString(direction, "Inlet", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				fixedAttachments = stream.DownstreamOpers;
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(direction, "Outlet", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				fixedAttachments = stream.UpstreamOpers;
			}
			else
			{
				Operators.CompareString(direction, "Inlet/Outlet", TextCompare: false);
			}
			if (fixedAttachments.Count == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return Operators.CompareString(((_IOperation)fixedAttachments[0]).TypeName, "feederblock", TextCompare: false) == 0;
		}

		internal string getHYMsg()
		{

		}

		private void DestroyMaterial(ref string name)

					object fld = null;
					materialClass2.SetFluid(ref fld);
					materialClass = (MaterialClass)m_materials.Item(ref i);

				}
			}
			materialClass = null;
		}

		private string GetQualifier(ref string direction)
		{
			if ((Operators.CompareString(direction, "Inlet", TextCompare: false) == 0) | (Operators.CompareString(direction, "Input", TextCompare: false) == 0))
			{
				return "AttachedInputs1";
			}
			if ((Operators.CompareString(direction, "Outlet", TextCompare: false) == 0) | (Operators.CompareString(direction, "Output", TextCompare: false) == 0))
			{
				return "AttachedOutputs1";
			}
			if ((Operators.CompareString(direction, "Inlet/Outlet", TextCompare: false) == 0) | (Operators.CompareString(direction, "Input/Output", TextCompare: false) == 0))
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal void SetCOMThermoModel([Optional][DefaultParameterValue("")] ref string flashModel)
		{
			if (hyUtils.isCOMThermo())
			{
				if (Operators.CompareString(flashModel, "", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					flashModel = "hysysflash.xml";
				}
				int num = m_materials.Count();
				for (int i = 1; i <= num; i = checked(i + 1))
				{
					MaterialClass obj = (MaterialClass)m_materials.Item(ref i);
					string text = vaporModel;
					string text2 = liquidModel;
					obj.SetCOMThermoModel(ref text, ref text2, ref flashModel);
					liquidModel = text2;
					vaporModel = text;
				}
			}
		}

		public object ICapeMaterialTemplateSystem_CreateMaterialTemplate(string materialTemplateName)
		{
			CMaterialTemplate cMaterialTemplate = new CMaterialTemplate();
			object result = null;
			object v = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(m_Container.SimulationCase.BasisManager.FluidPackages.Names);
			object e = materialTemplateName;
			bool num = Utils.contains(ref v, ref e);
			materialTemplateName = Conversions.ToString(e);
			if (!num)
			{
				m_error.setArgumentPosition(1);
				m_error.setCOError("NamedValue", "Template Name not supported", eCapeErrorInterfaceHR_tag.ECapeBadArgumentHR, 0, "ICapeMaterialTemplateSystem");
			}
			else
			{
				FluidPackage fp = (FluidPackage)m_Container.SimulationCase.BasisManager.FluidPackages[materialTemplateName];
				ActiveXtension parent = this;
				cMaterialTemplate.Initialize(ref fp, ref parent);
				result = cMaterialTemplate;
			}

	[StandardModule]
	internal sealed class COGents
	{
		public enum PortMatrix_enum
		{
			PortMatrixPortName,
			PortMatrixDir,
			PortMatrixType,
			PortMatrixFluidName
		}

		public enum Monitoring_Enum
		{
			monNo,
			monYes,
			monOnlyFailed
		}

		[MethodImpl(MethodImplOptions.NoInlining | MethodImplOptions.NoOptimization)]
		public static void COGents_InterpretNotification(ref string msg, ref ActiveXtension ActX)
		{
			_ = (ICapeUnit)ActX.capeunit;
			ActiveXtension obj = ActX;
			string varName = "MyConfig";
			InternalTextVariable EDFConfig = (InternalTextVariable)obj.findVariable(ref varName).Variable;
			if (Operators.CompareString(msg, "RDATAOnto", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				RDATAOnto(ref EDFConfig, ref ActX);
			}
			else if (Strings.InStr(1, msg, "WDATA", CompareMethod.Text) == 1)
			{
				string portName = Strings.Right(msg, checked(Strings.Len(msg) - Strings.Len("WDATA")));
				EDFConfig.Value = WDATA(ref ActX, ref portName);
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(msg, "RDATA", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				RDATA(ref EDFConfig, ref ActX);
			}
			else if (COIdentifiers.sameId(msg, "DisconnectPort"))
			{
				string portName = EDFConfig.Value;
				string XMLstring = WDATA(ref ActX, ref portName);
				disconnectPorts(ref XMLstring, ref ActX);
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(msg, "Notify", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				Unit93Wrapper obj2 = (Unit93Wrapper)ActX.capeunit;
				CapeMonitoring capeMonitoring = new CapeMonitoring();
				capeMonitoring.InitPMEListener();
				obj2.myMonitoring = capeMonitoring;
			}
			else if (Operators.CompareString(msg, "NotifyEnd", TextCompare: false) == 0)
			{
				((Unit93Wrapper)ActX.capeunit).myMonitoring = null;
			}
			else
			{
				Information.Err().Raise(100, "Unit socket", "notification message " + msg + " is not valid");
			}
		}

		private static string CreatePortRow(ref ICapeUnitPort ICUP)
		{
			ICapeIdentification capeIdentification = (ICapeIdentification)ICUP.connectedObject;
			string text3 = default(string);
			if (capeIdentification != null)
			{
				string componentName = capeIdentification.ComponentName;
				capeIdentification = (ICapeIdentification)ICUP;
				string componentName2 = capeIdentification.ComponentName;
				string text = default(string);
				switch (ICUP.direction)
				{
				case CapePortDirection.CAPE_INLET:
					text = "Inlet";
					break;
				case CapePortDirection.CAPE_OUTLET:
					text = "Outlet";
					break;
				case CapePortDirection.CAPE_INLET_OUTLET:
					text = "Inlet/Outlet";
					break;
				}

		}

		public static bool isCapePhase(ref string phase)
		{
			bool result = true;
			object str_Renamed = phase;
			string text = CapeId(ref str_Renamed);
			phase = Conversions.ToString(str_Renamed);
			string left = text;
			str_Renamed = "Vapor";
			if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				str_Renamed = "Liquid";
				if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					str_Renamed = "Solid";
					if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
					{
						str_Renamed = "VaporLiquid";
						if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
						{
							str_Renamed = "LiquidLiquid";
							if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
							{
								str_Renamed = "Overall";

								{
									str_Renamed = "Liquid1";

									{
										str_Renamed = "Liquid2";

										{
											result = false;

								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool maybePure(ref string propName)
		{
			bool result = false;
			object str_Renamed = propName;
			string text = CapeId(ref str_Renamed);
			propName = Conversions.ToString(str_Renamed);
			string left = text;
			str_Renamed = "temperature";
			if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				str_Renamed = "pressure";
				if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					result = !measuresFractionsOrFlows(ref propName);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool mayBeCalculated(ref string nonConstProp)
		{
			return !measuresFractionsOrFlows(ref nonConstProp) & !sameId(nonConstProp, "temperature") & !sameId(nonConstProp, "pressure");
		}

		public static bool measuresFractionsOrFlows(ref string propName)
		{
			bool result = true;

			propName = Conversions.ToString(str_Renamed);

			str_Renamed = "flow";

			{
				str_Renamed = "totalFlow";
				if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					str_Renamed = "phaseFraction";
					if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
					{
						str_Renamed = "fraction";
						if (Operators.CompareString(left, CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)

						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool isDerivative(ref string prop)
		{
			bool result = false;
			object str_Renamed = prop;
			string @string = CapeId(ref str_Renamed);
			prop = Conversions.ToString(str_Renamed);
			if (Strings.InStr(1, @string, ".D") >= 1)
			{
				if (isTderivative(ref prop))
				{
					result = true;
				}
				else if (isPderivative(ref prop))
				{
					result = true;
				}
				else if (isMolesDerivative(ref prop))
				{
					result = true;
				}
				else if (isFractionDerivative(ref prop))
				{
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static string getRootProperty(ref object prop)
		{
			int num = Strings.InStr(1, CapeId(ref prop), ".D");
			if (num == 0)
			{
				return Conversions.ToString(prop);
			}
			return Strings.Left(Conversions.ToString(prop), checked(num - 1));
		}

		public static string getValidPhase(ref string nonConstProp)
		{
			if (acceptsTwoPhase(ref nonConstProp))
			{
				return "VaporLiquid";
			}
			if (acceptsOnlyOverall(ref nonConstProp))
			{
				return "Overall";
			}
			if (sameId(nonConstProp, "compressibility") | sameId(nonConstProp, "compressibilityFactor"))
			{
				return "Vapor";
			}
			return "Liquid";
		}

			return Conversions.ToString(Interaction.IIf(acceptsMixture(ref nonConstProp), "Mixture", null));
		}

		public static bool propAcceptsPhase(ref string nonConstProp, ref string phaseName)
		{
			if ((Strings.Len(nonConstProp) == 0) | (Strings.Len(phaseName) == 0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (sameId(phaseName, "Overall"))
			{
				return acceptsOverall(ref nonConstProp);
			}
			bool flag = acceptsTwoPhase(ref nonConstProp);
			if (isTwoPhase(ref phaseName))
			{
				return flag;
			}
			return !flag;
		}

			{
				q.isSetting = isSetting;
			}
		}

		public static object GetPropAuto(ref ICapeThermoMaterialObject matobj, string property_Renamed, [Optional][DefaultParameterValue(null)] ref object phase)
		{
			if (Information.IsNothing(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(phase)))
			{
				phase = getValidPhase(ref property_Renamed);
			}
			object objectValue;
			while (true)
			{
				string CalcType = getCalctype(ref property_Renamed);
				string basis = getBasis(ref property_Renamed);
				string phase2 = Conversions.ToString(phase);
				object compIds = null;
				objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(safeGetProp(ref matobj, ref property_Renamed, ref phase2, ref compIds, ref CalcType, ref basis));
				if (!Conversions.ToBoolean(Operators.AndObject(Information.IsNothing(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue)) & sameId(property_Renamed, "surfaceTension"), Operators.CompareObjectEqual(phase, "VaporLiquid", TextCompare: false))))
				{
					break;
				}
				phase = "Liquid";
			}
			return objectValue;
		}

		public static string COTHmodel2filename(ref string model, ref string COphase)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (COIdentifiers.sameId(COphase, "Vapor"))
			{
				COphase = "Vapour";
			}
			int num = Information.UBound(XMLMatrix, 2);
			for (int i = 0; i <= num; i = checked(i + 1))
			{
				if (COIdentifiers.sameId(COphase, XMLMatrix[1, i]) && COIdentifiers.sameId(model, XMLMatrix[2, i]))
				{
					result = XMLMatrix[0, i];
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static COProperty FindCOProperty(string propName)
		{
			Module_Initialize();
			foreach (COProperty properties in m_propertiesList)
			{
				if (COIdentifiers.sameId(properties.name, propName))
				{
					return properties;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void HY2COarray(ref object hyValue, ref PropQualif q, ref hyUtils.HYcallbacks hyphase)
		{
			double mult = default(double);
			double Add = default(double);
			double pow = default(double);
			setMultAdd(ref mult, ref Add, ref pow, ref q, ref hyphase);
			int num = Information.LBound((Array)hyValue);
			int num2 = Information.UBound((Array)hyValue);
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i = checked(i + 1))
			{

				{
					i,

		internal double HY2CO(double hyValue, ref PropQualif q, ref hyUtils.HYcallbacks hyphase)
		{
			double mult = default(double);
			double Add = default(double);
			double pow = default(double);
			setMultAdd(ref mult, ref Add, ref pow, ref q, ref hyphase);
			return HY2COcore(hyValue, ref mult, ref Add, ref pow, ref q, ref hyphase);
		}

		internal double HY2COcore(double hyValue, ref double mult, ref double Add, ref double pow, ref PropQualif q, ref hyUtils.HYcallbacks hyphase)
		{
			double hY2COexp = m_HY2COexp;
			if (hY2COexp == 1.0)
			{
				hyValue = Math.Exp(hyValue);
			}
			else if (hY2COexp == -1.0)
			{
				hyValue = Math.Log(hyValue);
			}
			if (pow != 1.0)
			{
				hyValue = Math.Pow(hyValue, pow);
			}
			double num = mult * hyValue + Add;
			return num * postHY2CO(ref hyphase, ref q);
		}

		internal double CO2HY(double coValue, ref PropQualif q, ref hyUtils.HYcallbacks hyphase)
		{
			double mult = default(double);
			double Add = default(double);
			double pow = default(double);
			setMultAdd(ref mult, ref Add, ref pow, ref q, ref hyphase);
			double num = coValue - Add;
			num = ((mult == 0.0) ? 0.0 : (num / mult));
			double num2 = default(double);
			if (pow != 1.0)
			{
				num2 = Math.Pow(num2, 1.0 / pow);
			}
			double hY2COexp = m_HY2COexp;
			if (hY2COexp == -1.0)
			{
				num2 = Math.Exp(num2);
			}
			else if (hY2COexp == 1.0)
			{
				num2 = Math.Log(num2);
			}
			return num / postHY2CO(ref hyphase, ref q);
		}

		private void setMultAdd(ref double mult, ref double Add, ref double pow, ref PropQualif q, ref hyUtils.HYcallbacks hyphase)
		{
			if (COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.basis), "mole"))
			{
				mult = m_HY2COMoleMult;
				Add = m_HY2COMoleAdd;
				pow = m_HY2COMolePow;
			}
			else
			{
				mult = m_HY2COMassMult;
				Add = m_HY2COMassAdd;
				pow = m_HY2COMassPow;
			}
			if (!COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.PropNames), "phaseFraction"))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (q.isSetting)
			{
				if (COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.phases), "Liquid") | COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.phases), "Liquid2"))
				{
					mult = -1.0;
					Add = 1.0;
				}
				else if (COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.phases), "Solid"))
				{
					mult = 0.0;
					Add = 0.0;
				}
				else if (COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.phases), "Overall"))
				{
					mult = 0.0;
					Add = 1.0;
				}
			}
			else if (hyphase.fluid.FlashStatus == FlashStatus_enum.fsFlashOK)
			{
				mult = 1.0;
				Add = 0.0;
			}
			else if (COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.phases), "Liquid") | COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.phases), "Liquid2"))
			{
				mult = -1.0;
				Add = 1.0;
			}
		}

		private bool hyVarIsKnown(ref object hyvariable)
		{
			object objectValue = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(NewLateBinding.LateGet(hyvariable, null, "isKnown", new object[0], null, null, null));
			bool result = true;
			if (Information.VarType(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(objectValue)) == VariantType.Boolean)
			{
				result = Conversions.ToBoolean(objectValue);
			}
			else
			{
				int num = Information.LBound((Array)objectValue);
				int num2 = Information.UBound((Array)objectValue);
				for (int i = num; i <= num2; i = checked(i + 1))
				{
					if (Conversions.ToBoolean(Operators.NotObject(NewLateBinding.LateIndexGet(objectValue, new object[1] { i }, null))))
					{
						result = false;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool propIsOnPhase(ref hyUtils.HYcallbacks hyphase)
		{
			if (hyphase.fluidPhase != null && hyphase.fluidPhase is FluidPhase)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool result = default(bool);
			return result;
		}

		internal double postHY2CO(ref hyUtils.HYcallbacks hyphase, ref PropQualif q)
		{
			double result = 1.0;
			if (COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.PropNames), "compressibility"))
			{
				result = Conversions.ToDouble(Operators.DivideObject(0.001, NewLateBinding.LateGet(NewLateBinding.LateGet(hyphase.fluidPhase, null, "Pressure", new object[0], null, null, null), null, "getValue", new object[1] { "kPa" }, null, null, null)));
			}
			else if (COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(q.PropNames), "phaseFraction") && propIsOnPhase(ref hyphase) && !q.isSetting && hyphase.fluid.FlashStatus == FlashStatus_enum.fsFlashOK && hyphase.fluid.MolarFlow.IsKnown && Math.Abs(hyphase.fluid.MolarFlow.Value) > 1E-30)
			{
				result = 1.0 / hyphase.fluid.MolarFlow.Value;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool propIsSpecial(string propName)
		{
			bool result = true;
			string left = Strings.UCase(propName);

			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public bool isTBPprop(ref string COpropName)
		{

			COpropName = Conversions.ToString(str_Renamed);
			string left = text;
			str_Renamed = "TBPCurve";

			{
				str_Renamed = "CutPointCurve";
				if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					str_Renamed = "D86CorrectedCurve";

		private string activityErrorMsg(ref PropQualif pq, ref bool whenRegistering)
		{
			string result = string.Empty;
			if (Strings.InStr(1, Conversions.ToString(pq.PropNames), "activitY") >= 0)
			{
				if (whenRegistering)
				{
					result = " because the thermo model is not activity based.";
				}
				else if (!COIdentifiers.sameId(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(pq.phases), "Liquid"))
				{
					result = " because the property is only defined for Liquid phase.";
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static bool clipboardStroke(ref DataGridView grid, ref short KeyCode, ref bool shift, ref bool control)
		{
			bool result = true;
			if (control & ((KeyCode == 67) | (KeyCode == 45)))
			{
				EditCopy(ref grid);
			}
			else if ((control & (KeyCode == 88)) | (shift & (KeyCode == 46)))
			{
				EditCut(ref grid);
			}
			else if ((control & (KeyCode == 86)) | (shift & (KeyCode == 45)))
			{
				EditPaste(ref grid);
			}
			else if (!control)
			{
				result = false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void EditCut(ref DataGridView grid)
		{
			EditCopy(ref grid);
			EditDelete(ref grid);
		}

		private static void EditCopy(ref DataGridView grid)
		{
			if (grid.CurrentCell != null && grid.CurrentCell.Value != null)
			{
				MyProject.Computer.Clipboard.Clear();
				string text = grid.CurrentCell.Value.ToString();
				MyProject.Computer.Clipboard.SetText(text);
			}
		}

		private static void EditPaste(ref DataGridView grid)
		{
			string text = MyProject.Computer.Clipboard.GetText().Replace("\r", "").Replace("\n", "");
			putTextToSelectedCell(ref grid, ref text);
		}

		private static void EditDelete(ref DataGridView grid)
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			putTextToSelectedCell(ref grid, ref text);
		}

		public static string getSelectedTextFromGrid(ref DataGridView grid)
		{
			if (grid.SelectedCells.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (grid.SelectedCells[0].Value == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return grid.SelectedCells[0].Value.ToString();
		}

		public static string getTextFromGrid(ref DataGridView grid, int row, int col)
		{
			if (row >= 0 && row < grid.Rows.Count && col >= 0 && col < grid.Rows[row].Cells.Count)
			{
				if (grid.Rows[row].Cells[col].Value != null)
				{
					return grid.Rows[row].Cells[col].Value.ToString();
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		}

			}
		}

		public static void updateCursor(ref DataGridView grid)
		{
			if (grid.CurrentCell != null)
			{
				updateCursor(ref grid, grid.CurrentCell.RowIndex, grid.CurrentCell.ColumnIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				updateCursor(ref grid, 0, 0);
			}
		}

		public static void updateCursor(ref DataGridView grid, int row, int col)
		{
			checked
			{
				if (row < grid.Rows.Count - 1)
				{
					row++;
				}
				SelectCell(ref grid, row, col);
				grid.Select();
			}
		}

		public static void SelectCell(ref DataGridView grid, int row, int col)
		{
			if (row >= 0 && row < grid.Rows.Count && col >= 0 && col < grid.Columns.Count)
			{
				grid.CurrentCell = grid.Rows[row].Cells[col];
			}
		}

		private void updateMatrix(ref DataGridView grid, ref int row, ref int col)
		{
			string portType = FormUtils.getTextFromGrid(ref grid, row, 1);
			string direction = FormUtils.getTextFromGrid(ref grid, row, 2);
			string portName = FormUtils.getTextFromGrid(ref grid, row, 0);
			if (Operators.CompareString(cboEntries.Text, null, TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				string nameOfFluid = cboEntries.Text;
				int row2 = row;
				int col2 = col;
				ComboBox comboBox;
				string text = (comboBox = cboEntries).Text;
				FormUtils.putTextToGrid(ref grid, row2, col2, ref text);
				comboBox.Text = text;
				parent_Renamed.Connect(ref direction, ref portType, ref portName, ref nameOfFluid);
				parent_Renamed.FillConnectionsMatrix(ref grid);
				ActiveXtension activeXtension = parent_Renamed;
				TextBox trace = txtTrace;
				bool bUnitChanged = true;
				activeXtension.UpdateTraceWindow(ref trace, ref bUnitChanged);
				txtTrace = trace;
			}
		}

		private void cboEntries_SelectionChangeCommited(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			cboEntries.Text = Conversions.ToString(cboEntries.SelectedItem);
			cboEntries_KeyPress(cboEntries, new KeyPressEventArgs('\r'));
		}

		private void cboEntries_KeyDown(object eventSender, KeyEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			checked

		private bool allStreamsUseCOMThermo()
		{
			bool result = true;
			ActiveXtension activeXtension = parent_Renamed;
			if (activeXtension.materials.Count() == 0)
			{
				result = hyUtils.isHYSYS31() & hyUtils.fluidPackUsesCOMThermo(activeXtension.hContainer.Flowsheet.FluidPackage);
			}
			else
			{
				int num = activeXtension.materials.Count();
				int index = 1;
				while (index <= num)
				{
					if (((MaterialClass)activeXtension.materials.Item(ref index)).exposesCOMThermoProps())
					{
						index = checked(index + 1);
						continue;
					}
					goto IL_005d;
				}
			}
			activeXtension = null;
			goto IL_006b;
			IL_005d:
			result = false;
			goto IL_006b;
			IL_006b:
			return result;
		}

		{

			{
			case '\u0016':
				if (fgConnections.CurrentCell != null && fgConnections.CurrentCell.Value != null)
				{
					cboEntries.Text = fgConnections.CurrentCell.Value.ToString();
				}
				cboEntries_KeyPress(cboEntries, new KeyPressEventArgs('\r'));
				return;
			case '\u0003':
			case '\u0018':
				return;
			}
			if (fgConnections.SelectedCells.Count > 0)
			{
				DataGridViewCell dataGridViewCell = fgConnections.SelectedCells[0];
				colfgConnections = dataGridViewCell.ColumnIndex;
				rowfgConnections = dataGridViewCell.RowIndex;
			}
			char keyascii = eventArgs.KeyChar;
			object combo = cboEntries;
			Utils.forwardKeyAscii(ref keyascii, ref combo);
			cboEntries = (ComboBox)combo;
			eventArgs.KeyChar = keyascii;
		}

		public void resetCOMThermo()

		private void lstVapor_DoubleClick(object eventSender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (lstVapor.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				string vapPP = lstVapor.SelectedItem.ToString();
				txtVapor.Text = vapPP;
				COMTh2Hy.VapPP = vapPP;
				ActiveXtension activeXtension = parent_Renamed;
				TextBox textBox;
				string model = (textBox = txtVapor).Text;
				string COphase = "Vapor";
				string vaporModel = COMTh2Hy.COTHmodel2filename(ref model, ref COphase);
				textBox.Text = model;
				activeXtension.vaporModel = vaporModel;
				resetCOMThermo();
			}
		}

		private void lstLiquid_DoubleClick(object eventSender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (lstLiquid.SelectedItem != null)
			{
				string liqPP = lstLiquid.SelectedItem.ToString();
				txtLiquid.Text = liqPP;
				COMTh2Hy.LiqPP = liqPP;
				ActiveXtension activeXtension = parent_Renamed;
				TextBox textBox;
				string model = (textBox = txtLiquid).Text;
				string COphase = "Liquid";
				string liquidModel = COMTh2Hy.COTHmodel2filename(ref model, ref COphase);
				textBox.Text = model;
				activeXtension.liquidModel = liquidModel;
				resetCOMThermo();
			}
		}

		private void cmdRefreshXML_Click(object eventSender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			COMTh2Hy.LoadXML();
			string[] vapor = default(string[]);
			string[] liquid = default(string[]);
			string[] flash = default(string[]);
			COMTh2Hy.GetVectors(ref vapor, ref liquid, ref flash);
			ListBox list = lstVapor;
			COMTh2Hy.FromVec2List(ref vapor, ref list);
			lstVapor = list;
			list = lstLiquid;
			COMTh2Hy.FromVec2List(ref liquid, ref list);

		private void cmdRemove_Click(object eventSender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (fgValues.Rows.Count > 1)

			}
			else

				Interaction.Beep();
			}
		}

		private int maxVariables()
		{
			return Conversions.ToInteger(Interaction.IIf(m_maxVariables < 0, 99999, m_maxVariables));
		}

		private bool greater(ref double a, ref double b)
		{
			return a - b > 1E-10;
		}

		private string readAndValidate()
		{
			int try0000_dispatch = -1;
			int num2 = default(int);
			string result = default(string);
			int num = default(int);
			while (true)
			{
				try
				{
					/*Note: ILSpy has introduced the following switch to emulate a goto from catch-block to try-block*/;
					checked
					{
						switch (try0000_dispatch)
						{
						default:
							ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
							num2 = 2;
							if (fgValues.Rows.Count >= 1)
							{
								string[] array = new string[fgValues.Rows.Count - 1 + 1];
								int count = fgValues.Rows.Count;
								for (int i = 1; i <= count; i++)
								{
									int num3 = i - 1;
									DataGridView grid = fgValues;
									string textFromGrid = FormUtils.getTextFromGrid(ref grid, i - 1, 3);
									fgValues = grid;
									array[num3] = textFromGrid;
								}
								object value = array;
								txtTrace.Text = "Error validating vector";
								result = parent_Renamed.PutVectorVariableValues(ref varName, ref value);
								TextBox trace = txtTrace;
								UpdateTraceWindow(ref trace);
								txtTrace = trace;
							}
							goto end_IL_0000;
						case 246:
							num = -1;
							switch (num2)
							{
							case 2:
								txtTrace.BackColor = ColorTranslator.FromOle(255);
								txtTrace.Text = Information.Err().Description;
								Information.Err().Description = null;
								goto end_IL_0000;
							}
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (object obj) when (obj is Exception && num2 != 0 && num == 0)
				{
					ProjectData.SetProjectError((Exception)obj);
					try0000_dispatch = 246;
					continue;
				}
				throw ProjectData.CreateProjectError(-2146828237);
				continue;
				end_IL_0000:
				break;
			}
			if (num != 0)
			{
				ProjectData.ClearProjectError();
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void UpdateTraceWindow(ref TextBox trace)
		{
			trace.Text = getHYMsg();
			trace.BackColor = ColorTranslator.FromOle(getHYColor());
		}

		private string getValidMsg()
		{
			string message = default(string);
			_ = (object)m_param.Validate(ref message);
			return message;
		}

		private object getParamDefault(ref int position)
		{
			ICapeParameterSpec capeParameterSpec = (ICapeParameterSpec)NewLateBinding.LateIndexGet(((ICapeArrayParameterSpec)(ICapeParameterSpec)m_param.Specification).ItemsSpecifications, new object[1] { checked(position - 1) }, null);
			return capeParameterSpec.Type switch
			{
				CapeParamType.CAPE_REAL => ((ICapeRealParameterSpec)capeParameterSpec).DefaultValue, 
				CapeParamType.CAPE_INT => ((ICapeIntegerParameterSpec)capeParameterSpec).DefaultValue, 
				CapeParamType.CAPE_BOOLEAN => ((ICapeBooleanParameterSpec)capeParameterSpec).DefaultValue, 
				CapeParamType.CAPE_OPTION => ((ICapeOptionParameterSpec)capeParameterSpec).DefaultValue, 
				_ => EmptyValue_enum.HEmpty, 
			};
		}

		private object getLowerBound(ref int position)
		{
			ICapeParameterSpec capeParameterSpec = (ICapeParameterSpec)NewLateBinding.LateIndexGet(((ICapeArrayParameterSpec)(ICapeParameterSpec)m_param.Specification).ItemsSpecifications, new object[1] { checked(position - 1) }, null);
			if (capeParameterSpec.Type == CapeParamType.CAPE_REAL)
			{
				return ((ICapeRealParameterSpec)capeParameterSpec).LowerBound;
			}
			if (capeParameterSpec.Type == CapeParamType.CAPE_INT)
			{
				return ((ICapeIntegerParameterSpec)capeParameterSpec).LowerBound;
			}
			return EmptyValue_enum.HEmpty;
		}

		private object getUpperBound(ref int position)
		{
			ICapeParameterSpec capeParameterSpec = (ICapeParameterSpec)NewLateBinding.LateIndexGet(((ICapeArrayParameterSpec)(ICapeParameterSpec)m_param.Specification).ItemsSpecifications, new object[1] { checked(position - 1) }, null);
			if (capeParameterSpec.Type == CapeParamType.CAPE_REAL)
			{
				return ((ICapeRealParameterSpec)capeParameterSpec).UpperBound;
			}
			if (capeParameterSpec.Type == CapeParamType.CAPE_INT)
			{
				return ((ICapeIntegerParameterSpec)capeParameterSpec).UpperBound;
			}
			return EmptyValue_enum.HEmpty;
		}

		internal string getHYMsg()
		{
			string text = string.Empty;
			string text2;
			switch (m_param.ValStatus)
			{
			case CapeValidationStatus.CAPE_NOT_VALIDATED:
				text2 = "Not Validated. ";
				break;
			case CapeValidationStatus.CAPE_INVALID:
				text2 = "Invalid: ";
				text = getValidMsg();
				break;
			case CapeValidationStatus.CAPE_VALID:
				text2 = "Valid";
				getValidMsg();
				break;
			default:
				text2 = string.Empty;
				break;
			}
			if (Strings.Len(text) > 0)
			{
				text2 += text;
			}
			return text2;
		}

		internal int getHYColor()
		{
			int result = 32768;
			if (m_param.ValStatus != CapeValidationStatus.CAPE_VALID)
			{
				result = 255;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void cmdExit_Click(object eventSender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (fgValues.Rows.Count < 1)
			{
				txtTrace.Text = "There should be at least 1 item.";
				return;
			}
			MsgBoxResult msgBoxResult = MsgBoxResult.Yes;
			string text = readAndValidate();
			if (Strings.Len(text) > 0)
			{
				msgBoxResult = Interaction.MsgBox("The values are not valid because " + text + ". Do you want to close the dialog anyway?", MsgBoxStyle.YesNo);
			}
			if (msgBoxResult == MsgBoxResult.Yes)
			{
				Hide();
			}
		}

		private void cmdResetArray_Click(object eventSender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (checked((short)Interaction.MsgBox("This action will reset all array items.\r\nProceed anyway?", MsgBoxStyle.Exclamation | MsgBoxStyle.YesNo, "Reset Array")) != 7)
			{
				m_param.Reset();
				somethingChanged = true;
				ActiveXtension activeXtension = parent_Renamed;
				ref string reference = ref varName;
				DataGridView matrix = fgValues;
				Label label = lblType;
				Label lblmsg = lblAdjustFactor;
				activeXtension.FillVectorVariableMatrix(ref reference, ref matrix, ref label, ref lblmsg);
				lblAdjustFactor = lblmsg;
				lblType = label;
				fgValues = matrix;
				ActiveXtension activeXtension2 = parent_Renamed;
				TextBox trace = txtTrace;
				bool bUnitChanged = true;
				activeXtension2.UpdateTraceWindow(ref trace, ref bUnitChanged);
				txtTrace = trace;
			}
		}

		}

		private void fgValues_KeyDownEvent(object eventSender, KeyEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			Form frm = this;
			short KeyCode = checked((short)eventArgs.KeyCode);
			short shift = (short)(0 - (eventArgs.Shift ? 1 : 0));
			if (Utils.accelerators(ref frm, ref KeyCode, ref shift))
			{
				return;
			}
			DataGridView grid = fgValues;
			checked
			{
				shift = (short)eventArgs.KeyCode;
				bool shift2 = eventArgs.Shift;
				bool control = eventArgs.Control;
				bool num = FormUtils.clipboardStroke(ref grid, ref shift, ref shift2, ref control);
				fgValues = grid;
				if (!num)
				{
					grid = fgValues;
					FormUtils.getSelectedTextFromGrid(ref grid);
					fgValues = grid;
					if (eventArgs.KeyCode == Keys.Delete)
					{
						Interaction.Beep();
						return;
					}
					shift = (short)eventArgs.KeyCode;
					ComboBox combo = cboEntries;
					Utils.forwardKey(ref shift, ref combo);
					cboEntries = combo;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Display(ref ICapeParameter par, ref Utils.FormShowStyle winMode, ref int amaxVariables, [Optional][DefaultParameterValue(0)] ref CapeParamMode varMode)
		{
			if (varMode == CapeParamMode.CAPE_OUTPUT)
			{
				cmdAppend.Enabled = false;
				cmdRemove.Enabled = false;
				cmdResetArray.Enabled = false;
			}
			else
			{
				cmdAppend.Enabled = true;
				cmdRemove.Enabled = true;
				cmdResetArray.Enabled = true;
			}
			somethingChanged = false;
			txtTrace.Text = "Pending to be Validated";
			txtTrace.BackColor = ColorTranslator.FromOle(65535);
			m_maxVariables = amaxVariables;
			m_param = par;
			ActiveXtension activeXtension = parent_Renamed;
			ref string reference = ref varName;
			DataGridView matrix = fgValues;
			Label label = lblType;
			Label lblmsg = lblAdjustFactor;
			activeXtension.FillVectorVariableMatrix(ref reference, ref matrix, ref label, ref lblmsg);
			lblAdjustFactor = lblmsg;
			lblType = label;
			fgValues = matrix;
			matrix = fgValues;
			FormUtils.SelectCell(ref matrix, 0, 3);
			fgValues = matrix;
			TextBox trace = txtTrace;
			UpdateTraceWindow(ref trace);
			txtTrace = trace;
			Form frm = this;
			bool topMost = false;
			Utils.showUp(ref frm, ref winMode, ref topMost);
			parent_Renamed.GridChange = somethingChanged;
		}

		private void cboEntries_SelectionChangeCommited(object eventSender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			cboEntries.Text = Conversions.ToString(cboEntries.SelectedItem);
			cboEntries_KeyPress(cboEntries, new KeyPressEventArgs('\r'));
		}

		private void cboEntries_KeyPress(object eventSender, KeyPressEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			short num = (cboEntriesKeyPressed = checked((short)Strings.Asc(eventArgs.KeyChar)));
			if (!((cboEntriesKeyPressed != 13) & (cboEntriesKeyPressed != 0)))
			{
				switch (((ICapeParameterSpec)m_param.Specification).Type)
				{
				case CapeParamType.CAPE_REAL:
				case CapeParamType.CAPE_INT:
					if (!Versioned.IsNumeric(cboEntries.Text))
					{
						cboEntries.Text = null;
						Interaction.Beep();
						break;
					}
					goto default;
				case CapeParamType.CAPE_BOOLEAN:
					if (!Versioned.IsNumeric(cboEntries.Text) & ((Operators.CompareString(cboEntries.Text, "true", TextCompare: false) != 0) & (Operators.CompareString(cboEntries.Text, "false", TextCompare: false) != 0)))
					{
						cboEntries.Text = null;
						Interaction.Beep();
						break;
					}
					goto default;
				default:
				{
					DataGridView grid;
					if (Operators.CompareString(cboEntries.Text, null, TextCompare: false) != 0)
					{
						object obj = cboEntries.Text;
						grid = fgValues;
						string text = Conversions.ToString(obj);
						FormUtils.putTextToSelectedCell(ref grid, ref text);
						obj = text;
						fgValues = grid;
					}
					string left = readAndValidate();
					if (Operators.CompareString(left, "", TextCompare: false) != 0)
					{
						txtTrace.BackColor = ColorTranslator.FromOle(255);
						txtTrace.Text = left;
					}
					ActiveXtension activeXtension = parent_Renamed;
					ref string reference = ref varName;
					grid = fgValues;
					Label label = lblType;
					Label lblmsg = lblAdjustFactor;
					activeXtension.FillVectorVariableMatrix(ref reference, ref grid, ref label, ref lblmsg);
					lblAdjustFactor = lblmsg;
					lblType = label;
					fgValues = grid;
					somethingChanged = true;
					grid = fgValues;
					FormUtils.updateCursor(ref grid);
					fgValues = grid;
					fgValues.Select();
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			eventArgs.KeyChar = Strings.Chr(num);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				eventArgs.Handled = true;
			}
		}

		public void addRow()
		{
			if (fgValues.Rows.Count < maxVariables())
			{
				string[] array = new string[4]
				{
					varName + "_" + Conversions.ToString(fgValues.Rows.Count),
					null,
					null,
					null
				};
				int position = fgValues.Rows.Count;
				array[1] = getLowerBound(ref position).ToString();
				position = fgValues.Rows.Count;
				array[2] = getUpperBound(ref position).ToString();
				position = fgValues.Rows.Count;
				array[3] = getParamDefault(ref position).ToString();
				fgValues.Rows.Add(array);
			}
			somethingChanged = true;
		}

		private void fgValues_DblClick(object eventSender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			string text = "ArrayExportedVar";
			if (parent_Renamed.EnableLogicals.Value != 0.0)
			{
				if (((ICapeParameterSpec)NewLateBinding.LateIndexGet(((ICapeArrayParameterSpec)m_param.Specification).ItemsSpecifications, new object[1] { 0 }, null)).Type == CapeParamType.CAPE_REAL)
				{
					lblAdjustFactor.Visible = true;
					parent_Renamed.ExportedIndex = Conversions.ToInteger(Interaction.IIf(fgValues.SelectedCells.Count > 0, fgValues.SelectedCells[0].RowIndex, 0));
					Label label = lblAdjustFactor;
					DataGridView grid = fgValues;
					string textFromGrid = FormUtils.getTextFromGrid(ref grid, parent_Renamed.ExportedIndex, 0);
					fgValues = grid;
					label.Text = "Variable " + textFromGrid + " has been assigned succesfully to " + text;
					parent_Renamed.VarToExport = varName;
					somethingChanged = true;
				}
				else
				{
					lblAdjustFactor.Visible = false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				lblAdjustFactor.Visible = false;
			}
		}

		private void fgValues_ClickEvent(object eventSender, EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			ICapeParameterSpec capeParameterSpec = (ICapeParameterSpec)NewLateBinding.LateIndexGet(((ICapeArrayParameterSpec)(ICapeParameterSpec)m_param.Specification).ItemsSpecifications, new object[1] { 0 }, null);
			if (capeParameterSpec.Type == CapeParamType.CAPE_BOOLEAN)
			{
				ActiveXtension activeXtension = parent_Renamed;
				ComboBox cboNames = cboEntries;
				activeXtension.GenerateBooleanList(ref cboNames);
				cboEntries = cboNames;
			}
			else if (capeParameterSpec.Type == CapeParamType.CAPE_OPTION)
			{
				ICapeOptionParameterSpec capeOptionParameterSpec = (ICapeOptionParameterSpec)capeParameterSpec;
				ActiveXtension activeXtension2 = parent_Renamed;
				ComboBox cboNames = cboEntries;
				object optList = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(capeOptionParameterSpec.OptionList);
				activeXtension2.OptionListToCombo(ref cboNames, ref optList);
				cboEntries = cboNames;
			}
			else
			{
				cboEntries.Items.Clear();
			}
			ComboBox comboBox = cboEntries;
			DataGridView grid = fgValues;
			string selectedTextFromGrid = FormUtils.getSelectedTextFromGrid(ref grid);
			fgValues = grid;
			comboBox.Text = selectedTextFromGrid;
		}

		private void fgValues_EnterCell(object eventSender, DataGridViewCellEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			ComboBox comboBox = cboEntries;
			DataGridView grid = fgValues;
			string selectedTextFromGrid = FormUtils.getSelectedTextFromGrid(ref grid);
			fgValues = grid;
			comboBox.Text = selectedTextFromGrid;
		}

		private void fgValues_KeyPressEvent(object eventSender, KeyPressEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			switch (eventArgs.KeyChar)
			{
			case '\u0016':
				if (fgValues.CurrentCell != null && fgValues.CurrentCell.Value != null)
				{
					cboEntries.Text = fgValues.CurrentCell.Value.ToString();
				}
				cboEntries_KeyPress(cboEntries, new KeyPressEventArgs('\r'));
				break;
			default:
			{
				char keyascii = eventArgs.KeyChar;
				object combo = cboEntries;
				Utils.forwardKeyAscii(ref keyascii, ref combo);
				cboEntries = (ComboBox)combo;
				eventArgs.KeyChar = keyascii;
				break;
			}
			case '\u0003':
			case '\u0018':
				break;
			}
		}

		private void fgValues_LeaveCell(object eventSender, DataGridViewCellEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			ComboBox comboBox = cboEntries;
			DataGridView grid = fgValues;
			string selectedTextFromGrid = FormUtils.getSelectedTextFromGrid(ref grid);
			fgValues = grid;
			comboBox.Text = selectedTextFromGrid;
		}

		private void frmVectors_FormClosing(object eventSender, FormClosingEventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			bool cancel = eventArgs.Cancel;
			if ((eventArgs.CloseReason == CloseReason.UserClosing) & !zombie)
			{
				cancel = true;
				cmdExit_Click(cmdExit, new EventArgs());
			}
			eventArgs.Cancel = cancel;
		}

		public enum HYSYSportDirection

				i = Conversions.ToShort(a);

			}
		}

		private static int fromHysysIdToArrayPos(int hysysId)
		{
			if (hysysId < 1 || hysysId > 4000)
			{
				hysysId = -1;
			}
			if (hysysId >= 1000)
			{
				hysysId = checked(hysysId - 2000);
			}
			return hysysId;
		}

		private static int fromArrayPosToHysysId(int ArrayPos)
		{
			if (ArrayPos < 1 || ArrayPos > 2000)
			{
				ArrayPos = -1;
			}
			if (ArrayPos >= 1000)
			{
				ArrayPos = checked(ArrayPos + 2000);
			}
			return ArrayPos;
		}

		private static int LookUpComponentToID(ref string nameIn, ref bool useCAsno)
		{
			object amode = null;
			Utils.logVar("LookUpComponentToID: SLOW!!", ref amode);
			string text = Strings.Trim(nameIn);
			checked
			{
				int num;
				if (Operators.CompareString(Strings.Right(text, 1), "\0", TextCompare: false) == 0)
				{
					num = Strings.Len(text);
					text = Strings.Left(text, num - 1);
				}
				string @string = Strings.UCase(text);
				num = 1;
				do
				{
					string string2 = ((!useCAsno) ? Strings.UCase(m_rgComponentNames[num]) : Strings.UCase(m_rgCASNumber[num]));
					if (Strings.StrComp(string2, @string) == 0)
					{
						return fromArrayPosToHysysId(num);
					}
					num++;
				}
				while (num <= 2000);
				return -1;
			}
		}

			if (Utils.varLength(ref objectValue) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = Information.LBound((Array)objectValue);
			int num2 = Information.UBound((Array)objectValue);
			for (int i = num; i <= num2; i = checked(i + 1))

		}

		public static bool WaitTillModifiable(ref ExtnUnitOperationContainer hycontainer, ref _HVariable hvar, short maxIterations = 0, short sleepLength = 0)
		{
			double status = 1.0;
			return waitTillVarStatus(ref hycontainer, ref hvar, ref status, maxIterations, sleepLength);
		}

		public static bool waitTillVarStatus(ref ExtnUnitOperationContainer hycontainer, ref _HVariable hvar, ref double status, short maxIterations = 0, short sleepLength = 0)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (maxIterations == 0)
			{
				maxIterations = 15;
			}
			if (sleepLength == 0)
			{
				sleepLength = 500;
			}
			while (maxIterations > 0 && !flag)
			{
				if (status == 1.0)
				{
					if (hvar.CanModify)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				else if (status == -32767.0 && hvar.IsKnown)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				hycontainer.WaitForTurn();
				maxIterations = checked((short)(maxIterations - 1));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public static bool waitTillValid(ref ExtnUnitOperationContainer hycontainer, ref _IRoot root, short maxIterations = 0, short sleepLength = 0)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (maxIterations == 0)
			{
				maxIterations = 15;
			}
			if (sleepLength == 0)
			{
				sleepLength = 500;
			}
			while (maxIterations > 0 && !flag)
			{
				if (root.IsValid)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				hycontainer.WaitForTurn();
				maxIterations = checked((short)(maxIterations - 1));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		public static string getUnitFromHyVar(ref _IRoot hyvar, ref bool settingValue)
		{
			double[] array = new double[1];
			if (hyVarNeedsUnits(ref hyvar))
			{
				object v = RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(NewLateBinding.LateGet(hyvar, null, "UnitConversionType", new object[0], null, null, null));
				UnitConversionType_enum Hytype;
				if (Utils.isArray_Renamed(ref v))
				{
					if (Utils.varLength(ref v) == 0)
					{
						if (!settingValue)
						{
							goto IL_00fe;
						}
						NewLateBinding.LateCall(hyvar, null, "SetBounds", new object[1] { 1 }, null, null, null, IgnoreReturn: true);

		public static string OptimizerStatusToMsg(ref double stats, ref short statusCol)
		{
			double num = stats;
			string result;

				statusCol = 0;

				result = "Optimum found (SmallDeltaF)";
				statusCol = 1;
			}

				result = "Optimizer is ready";
				statusCol = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				result = "Open Optimizer to check status";
				statusCol = 7;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public static string HYSYSvarRealName(string varName, ref short outVarIndex)
		{
			string text = Strings.Trim(varName);
			int num = Strings.InStr(1, text, "(");
			int num2 = Strings.InStrRev(text, ")");
			if (num > 0 && num2 > 0)
			{
				int num3 = Strings.InStr(1, text, "_");
				checked
				{
					if (num3 > 0)
					{
						outVarIndex = Conversions.ToShort(Strings.Mid(text, num3 + 1, num2 - num3 - 1));
					}
					text = Strings.Mid(text, num + 1, num2 - num - 1);
				}
			}
			return text;
		}

		private bool flashQuery(ref PropQualif q)

		private static object GetCCTolerance(ref string prop, ref ICapeThermoMaterialObject mo, ref string comp)
		{
			double num = 0.05;
			object str_Renamed = prop;
			string text = COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed);
			prop = Conversions.ToString(str_Renamed);
			string left = text;
			str_Renamed = "CASNO";
			if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
			{
				str_Renamed = "casRegistryNumber";
				if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
				{
					str_Renamed = "criticalTemperature";
					if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
					{
						str_Renamed = "criticalVolume";
						if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
						{
							str_Renamed = "criticalDensity";
							if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
							{
								str_Renamed = "criticalPressure";
								if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
								{
									str_Renamed = "CriticalCompressibilityFactor";
									if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
									{
										str_Renamed = "acentricFactor";
										if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) == 0)
										{
											num = ((!COIdentifiers.sameId(comp, CompHYDROGEN)) ? 0.15 : 0.5);
										}
										else
										{
											str_Renamed = "liquidDensityAt25C";
											if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
											{
												str_Renamed = "liquidVolumeAt25C";
												if (Operators.CompareString(left, COIdentifiers.CapeId(ref str_Renamed), TextCompare: false) != 0)
												{
													goto IL_01eb;
												}
											}
											if (Operators.ConditionalCompareObjectLess(NewLateBinding.LateIndexGet(mo.GetComponentConstant(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(SetGetProp.SASetProp("normalBoilingPoint")), RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(SetGetProp.SASetProp(comp))), new object[1] { 0 }, null), 298, TextCompare: false))
											{
												num = 0.9;
											}
										}
										goto IL_01eb;
									}
								}
								if (COIdentifiers.sameId(comp, CompHYDROGEN))
								{
									ShowHydrogenMsg();
									num = 1.0;
								}
								else if (COIdentifiers.sameId(comp, CompBIPHENYL))
								{
									num = 0.15;
								}
								goto IL_01eb;
							}
						}
					}
					if (COIdentifiers.sameId(comp, CompHYDROGEN))
					{
						ShowHydrogenMsg();
						num = 1.0;
					}
					goto IL_01eb;
				}
			}
			num = 0.0;
			goto IL_01eb;
			IL_01eb:
			return num;
		}

			}
		}

			if (Conversions.ToBoolean(NewLateBinding.LateGet(combo, null, "Visible", new object[0], null, null, null)))
			{
				NewLateBinding.LateCall(combo, null, "Focus", new object[0], null, null, null, IgnoreReturn: true);
				if (keyascii != '\r')
				{
					NewLateBinding.LateSet(combo, null, "SelectionLength", new object[1] { 0 }, null, null);
					NewLateBinding.LateSet(combo, null, "Text", new object[1] { keyascii }, null, null);
					NewLateBinding.LateSet(combo, null, "SelectionStart", new object[1] { Strings.Len(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(NewLateBinding.LateGet(combo, null, "Text", new object[0], null, null, null))) }, null, null);
				}
				else
				{
					NewLateBinding.LateSet(combo, null, "SelectionLength", new object[1] { Strings.Len(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(NewLateBinding.LateGet(combo, null, "Text", new object[0], null, null, null))) }, null, null);

		public static void forwardKey(ref short KeyCode, ref ComboBox combo)
		{
			if ((KeyCode > 47) & (KeyCode != 144))
			{
				combo.Text = Conversions.ToString(Strings.Chr(KeyCode));
				combo.Focus();
				combo.SelectionStart = Strings.Len(combo.Text);
				combo.SelectionLength = 0;
				combo.Text = null;
				if (KeyCode == 46)
				{
					combo.Text = Conversions.ToString(Strings.Chr(KeyCode));
				}
				else if ((KeyCode > 47) & (KeyCode <= 90))
				{
					combo.Text = Conversions.ToString(Strings.Chr(KeyCode));
				}
				else
				{
					short num = KeyCode;
					if (num >= 96 && num <= 105)
					{
						combo.Text = Conversions.ToString(checked(KeyCode - 96));
					}
					else
					{
						switch (num)
						{
						case 109:
							combo.Text = "-";
							break;
						case 110:
							combo.Text = ".";
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				combo.SelectionStart = Strings.Len(combo.Text);
			}
			else if ((KeyCode == 108) | (KeyCode == 13))
			{
				combo.Focus();
			}
		}

		}

		}

		public static string varTypeName(ref VariantType vt)
		{
			switch (vt)
			{
			case VariantType.Double:
				return "double";
			case VariantType.Integer:
				return "long";
			case VariantType.Boolean:
				return "bool";
			case VariantType.String:
				return "string";
			case VariantType.Short:
				return "(Non-long) integer";
			case VariantType.Null:
				return "null";
			case VariantType.Empty:
				return "Empty";
			case VariantType.Object:
				return "Variant";
			default:
				if (vt > VariantType.Array)
				{
					VariantType vt2 = checked(vt - 8192);
					return "Array of " + varTypeName(ref vt2);
				}
				return "<Unknown> (" + Conversions.ToString((int)vt) + ")";
			}
		}

		public static bool equalVariants(ref object v1, ref object v2)
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (Information.VarType(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(v1)) == Information.VarType(RuntimeHelpers.GetObjectValue(v2)))
			{

				{

					{

						int num2 = Information.UBound((Array)v1);
						for (int i = num; i <= num2; i = checked(i + 1))
						{

							NewLateBinding.LateIndexSetComplex(obj, new object[2] { obj2, v3 }, null, OptimisticSet: true, RValueBase: false);
							if (flag)

		public static bool iterativeParse(ref string s, ref short cursorPos, ref string extractedStr, string separator)
		{
			if (cursorPos > Strings.Len(s))
			{
				object msg = "zero";
				logTMP(ref msg);
				return false;
			}
			checked
			{
				if (Strings.Len(separator) == 0)
				{
					object msg = "sep zero";
					logTMP(ref msg);
					extractedStr = Strings.Right(s, cursorPos);
					cursorPos = (short)(Strings.Len(s) + 1);
				}
				else
				{
					object msg = "ok";
					logTMP(ref msg);
					int num = Strings.InStr(cursorPos, s, separator);
					msg = num;
					logTMP(ref msg);
					num = Conversions.ToInteger(msg);
					if (num == 0)
					{
						num = Strings.Len(s) + 1;
					}
					extractedStr = Strings.Mid(s, cursorPos, num - cursorPos);
					msg = extractedStr;
					logTMP(ref msg);
					extractedStr = Conversions.ToString(msg);
					extractedStr = Strings.Trim(extractedStr);
					msg = extractedStr;
					logTMP(ref msg);
					extractedStr = Conversions.ToString(msg);
					cursorPos = (short)(num + Strings.Len(separator));
					msg = cursorPos;
					logTMP(ref msg);
					cursorPos = Conversions.ToShort(msg);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}
